text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to greet Yamanin Zephyr after 
her brilliant performance in her debut 
race—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...I felt a definite wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The lush scent of grass, the lingering 
heat, the kicked-up dirt. Blowing right 
through it all with a roar—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: In that moment, I was the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It is still faint and weak, far from my 
ideal, and yet... it was undeniably a 
breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I knew it, it was here. It couldn't 
have been anywhere else...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Just as she said, we'll settle it in a 
race after all.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Only in the Twinkle Series can I become 
the true wind...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
“...Let us return to the academy at once, 
Trainer. And discuss our next race.”

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"A dead calm is simply unacceptable. Let 
us decide the wind's next destination."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though her tone is gentle, I can't help 
feeling overwhelmed by the lingering 
traces of a raging gale within her, yet 
somehow I manage to nod.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What comes next is crucial. Sprint, Mile, 
the royal road of the Classic Triple 
Crown. Or perhaps the Triple Tiara route—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Several paths lie open to the Umamusume. 
Among them, the path Yamanin Zephyr should 
take is—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: By all means, head for the mile route.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Without even needing to be asked, she 
declared it unequivocally.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod in agreement. As her Trainer, I feel 
the same. If she wants to make the most of 
her natural speed, going down the sprint 
or mile route is undoubtedly best.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even more than that, though... "winning on 
this route" must be what's truly important 
to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was precisely because she possessed 
such lofty ideals—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Placed 1st in the GⅠ "Yasuda Kinen." Won 
consecutive victories in the "Mile 
Championship."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A figure truly like a gust of fierce wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If I am to catch up to the one hailed as 
the "Emperor of the Mile"—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let us also tread the path of the wind. 
Right through the heart of the storm, 
seeking the pinnacle of instantaneous 
speed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no hesitation. Let us set 
'conquering the mile division' as our 
grand objective.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, the next step is setting 
specific target races. While focusing 
mainly on miles, we can also enter sprint 
races to hone your innate speed."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Assuming we choose from mile and sprint 
races, our first target will be—
choice_data_list: Let's go with the New Zealand Trophy.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "...A spring GII race? That would be—"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It has been quite a long wait for the 
wind... hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...A little. ...No, but—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I can understand your feelings, Trainer. 
Even now, the wind is blowing from your 
direction.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The gentle south wind, worrying over me. 
...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Then next shall be the New 
Zealand Trophy.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I shall become the spring tempest.
